validity.researcher_notes: Sheet records PipelineType=distribution; GEM's prior researcher note reasoned this is distribution 'as it starts at a gas distribution station.' But per every source found, the отвод runs from the connection point at the OLONETS ГРС (an existing trunk-side station) TO the NEWLY BUILT Pitkyaranta ГРС -- i.e. it is the ГРС-to-ГРС feeder line itself, the classic transmission-side (upstream-of-distribution) pattern this batch's guidance describes for a row named '<X> - ГРС <Y>.' The actual distribution networks are the separate 'межпоселковые газопроводы' and city gas networks downstream of the Pitkyaranta ГРС, which are NOT this row. No source explicitly classifies the object as 'transmission' or 'distribution' in so many words, so I did not stage a PipelineType fill -- flagging for a human classification call per the batch's flag-don't-reclassify instruction.

Two candidates surface repeatedly but neither is explicitly named 'operator' of the отвод itself: (1) АО «Газпром газораспределение Петрозаводск» -- Karelia's regional gas-distribution operator, credited (per rk.karelia.ru, its CEO Yuri Azarov quoted at the 2021 groundbreaking) with executing the build and running the GRS/downstream network; (2) ООО «Газпром межрегионгаз» -- named as the program's investor/press-service source (dp.ru); (3) OOO Gazprom Transgaz Sankt-Peterburg -- confirmed (via its own site, spb-tr.gazprom.ru/about) to hold the trunk-transmission zone of responsibility covering the Republic of Karelia generally, but no source ties it to THIS specific отвод by name. Per this batch's guidance, a distribution-side entity (Gazoraspredelenie) is not the отвод's operator, but I could not find a document that names the operator of the отвод (as distinct from the GRS/downstream network) with confidence. Left unresolved rather than picking one of the three.

Two independent, dated sources both report that on 26 Aug 2023 (Republic of Karelia Day), the gazoprovod-otvod Olonets-Pitkyaranta AND the newly built GRS Pitkyaranta were commissioned/put into operation (введены в эксплуатацию): stolicaonego.ru carries the regional government's press-service account of the ceremony (Karelia head Parfenchikov, Gazprom Mezhregiongaz CEO Gustov attending; first boiler house and households connected); rk.karelia.ru ('Karelia will become different with gas') is the outlet 'Respublika''s own correspondent coverage of the same ceremony -- independent origin, not a republish of the press release.
